item.title: Peripheral anatomy and central connectivity of proprioceptive sensory neurons in the <i>Drosophila</i> wing
item.description: Recent advances in electron microscopy (EM) and automated image segmentation have produced synaptic wiring diagrams of the Drosophila central nervous system. item.title: <i>EPB41L4A-AS1</i> long noncoding RNA acts in both <i>cis</i>- and <i>trans</i>-acting transcriptional regulation and controls nucleolar biology
item.description: Mammalian genomes are pervasively transcribed into long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs), whose functions and modes of action remain poorly understood. EPB41L4A-AS1 is an evolutionarily conserved, broadly and highly expressed lncRNA that produces the H/ACA snoRNA SNORA13 from one of its introns. item.title: Defining the chromatin-associated protein landscapes on <i>Trypanosoma brucei</i> repetitive elements using synthetic TALE proteins
item.description: Kinetoplastids, such as Trypanosoma brucei, are eukaryotes that likely separated from the main lineage at an exceptionally early point in evolution. Consequently, many aspects of kinetoplastid biology differ significantly from other eukaryotic model systems, including yeasts, plants, worms, flies, and mammals. item.title: Movie reconstruction from mouse visual cortex activity
item.description: The ability to reconstruct images represented by the brain has the potential to give us an intuitive understanding of what the brain sees. Reconstruction of visual input from human fMRI data has garnered significant attention in recent years. item.title: Replacing the immune system of the brain
item.description: A new method enables engineered immune progenitor cells to replace microglia in mice and reveals how a genetic mutation can lead to inflammation in the brain.

item.title: Multiple modes of cholesterol translocation in the human Smoothened receptor
item.description: Smoothened (SMO), a member of the G-protein-coupled receptor superfamily, mediates Hedgehog signaling and is linked to cancer and birth defects. SMO responds to accessible cholesterol in the ciliary membrane, translocating it via a longitudinal tunnel to its extracellular domain. item.description: Mosaic analysis has been instrumental in advancing developmental and cell biology. item.title: Precision cutaneous stimulation in freely moving mice
item.description: Somatosensation connects animals to their immediate environment, shaping critical behaviors essential for adaptation, learning, and survival.
